QuestInfo.name: It's Time for Monster Life!
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin was looking for a missing Pigmy in Monster Life! Go see if she needs help.
QuestInfo.1: Where could it have gone? It's tough out there for a little piggy. Go search around the hunting grounds.
QuestInfo.2:
The Maple Admin gave you a monster for your Monster Life farm!

Press the Go to Farm button, or the house-shaped button, to go to your Monster Life farm.#k

0.0: Um, hi. Did you happen to see a #b#o9500605##k on your way over here? My therapist told me I needed to take some time away from work, so I started a Monster Life farm, but then I forgot to close the gate last night and... This is going to look terrible on my record.

yes.0: Oh, thank you! I didn't think anything could be cuter than my collating printer, but this little guy really showed me something new. I hope he's okay, and hasn't been... eaten.

no.0: You don't play Monster Life? That's a shame.

1.0: My little munchkin! I was so worried...

yes.1:
#bClick on the Farm button in the menu or the house icon#k to visit your Monster Life farm.

#i3800456#   #i3800455#
yes.0: Goodness. Caring for items that don't fit in my filing cabinet is difficult, yet rewarding. I'd like you to experience the same thing. Please take this little monster to your farm and love it like it's your little pooky-wooky baby.
